loteria.verse:
I’m kissed on the dance floor and missed in the bed;
I’m pierced every February, and I always go red.
loteria.why: Kissed, missed, pierced by Cupid and always red: the Heart.

loteria.verse:
I’m peeled off at midnight, unlaced with a grin;
the higher my heel, the more trouble you’re in.
loteria.why: Unlaced at midnight, high heels and trouble: the Boot.

loteria.verse:
My tail’s an invitation, my song is a lure;
I’ve broken more sailors than storms, to be sure.
loteria.why: A tail and a song that wreck sailors: the Mermaid.

loteria.verse:
My suit is impeccable, my intentions are not;
I’ll walk you home slowly — and stay for a shot.
loteria.why: Impeccable suit, questionable intentions: the Dandy.

loteria.verse:
I’m wandering, wandering, under the table;
I hold yours at dinner — and more, if I’m able.
loteria.why: Wandering under the table: the Hand.

loteria.verse:
I climb to your window when your parents are out;
I’m a step-by-step plan for what love’s all about.
loteria.why: Up to the window while the parents are out: the Ladder.

loteria.verse:
I’m out every night but I never get caught;
lovers swear by me and do what they ought.
loteria.why: Out every night, the lovers’ witness: the Moon.

loteria.verse:
I spin my web slowly and wait in my lair;
my date ends at breakfast — but he won’t be there.
loteria.why: Spins her web and eats her date: the Spider.

loteria.verse:
Thrown at the singer by fans in the front;
given with thorns as a romantic stunt.
loteria.why: Thrown at singers and given with thorns: the Rose.

loteria.verse:
I serenade windows at quarter past two;
if the lights go off, I know what to do.
loteria.why: Serenading at 2 a.m., knows when the lights go off: the Musician.
